a: ईश — a. [ईश्-क] 1 Owning, possessing, sharing, master or lord of; see below. --2 One who is completely master of anything. --3 Capable of (with gen.). --4 Powerful, supreme. --शः 1 A lord, master; with gen. or in comp.; कथंचिदीशा मनसां बभूवुः Ku. 3. 34 with great difficulty controlled (were masters of) their minds; so वागीश, सुरेश &c. --2 A husband. --3 A Rudra. --4 The number 11 (derived from the eleven Rudras). --5 N. of Śiva (as regent of the northeast quarter). --शा 1 Supremacy, power, dominion, greatness. --2 N. of Durgā. --3 A woman having supremacy; a rich lady. --Comp. --कोणः the northeast quarter. --पुरी, --नगरी N. of Benares. --बलं the missile पाशुपत. --सरघः an epithet of Kubera.

k.v: शम्भूरीशः पशुपतिः शिवः शूली महेश्वरः। ईश्वरः शर्व ईशानः शङ्करश्चन्द्रशेखरः॥
कुबेरः ईशः पतयः पूर्वादीनां दिशां क्रमात्. रविः शुक्रो महीसूनुः स्वर्भानुर्भानुजो विधुः। बुधो बृहस्पतिश्चेति दिशां चैव तथा ग्रहाः। ऐरावतः पुण्डरीको वामनः कुमुदोऽञ्जनः॥

m: ईश—शक्ति f. the personified female energy of Śiva, L. (cf. RTL. 187)

। jYAnaYca DarmaSca jYAnaDarmO tayorupadeSena jYAnaDarmasamuYcayAllabDavivekaKyAtiparipAkAt । kalpapralaye--brahmaRodinAvasAne yatra satyalokavarjaMjagadastameti, mahApralaye sasatyalokasya brahmaRo'pi niDane, saMsAriRaH svakAraRagAminastadA maraRaduHKaBAjaH । kalpetyupalakzaRam । anyadApi svArjitakarmapAkavaSena janmamaraRAdiBAjaH puruzAnudDarizyAmIti kEvalyaM prApya puruvA udDftA BavantvityarTaH । etacca karuRAprayuktasya jYAnaDarmopadeSanaM kapilAnAmapi sidDamityAha, “taTA coktaM AdividvAn kapila” iti । AdividvAniti paYcaSiKAcAryyavacanam AdimuktasvasantAnAdiguruvizayaM, natvanAdimuktaparamaguruvizayam, Adimuktezu kadAcinmuktezu vidvatsu kapilezu asmAkamAdirvidvAn muktaH sa eva ca gururiti । kapilasyApi jAyamAnasya maheSvarAnugrahAdeva jYAnaprAptiH । SrUyate hi kapilonAma vizRoravatAraviSezaH prasidDaH svayaMBUstu hiraRyagarBaH, tasyApi sANKyayogaprAptirvede SrUyate iti “sa eveSvaraH AdividvAn kapilovizRuH svayamBUriti” svAyanmuvAdInAmapISvara iti BAvaH 25 । “samprati Bagavato brahmAdiByoviSezamAha, “sa eza iti pAtanikA na tu sUtram “pUrvezAmapi guruH kAlenAnavacCedAt” । vyAcazwe, pUrve hIti । kAlastu SatavarzAdiH, avacCedArTena avacCedanaprayojanenopAvarttate, na varttate prakarzasya gatiH prAptiH pratyetavyA AgamAt । tadanena prabanDena BagavAnISvarodarSitaH” 26 vAcaspativivaraRam । tasveSvarasya lakzaRam “janmAdyasyayataH” SA॰ sUtraBAzyayo rdarSitam taccopAdAnanimittakAraRoBayakAraRaparatayA samarTitaM taccAnupadamudAhftam । tasya lakzaRAni navamitAni yaTAha brahmaRastawasTalakzaRodAharaRevedA॰ pari॰ “prakfte ca jagajjanmAdikAraRatvam । atra jagatpadena kAryyajAtaM vivakzitam । kAraRatvaYca karttftvam ato 'vidyAdO nAtivyAptiH । kartftvaYca tattadupAdAnagocarAparokzajYAnacikorzAkftimattvam । ISvarasya tAvadupAdAnagocarAparokzajYAnasadBAve ca “yaH sarvvajYaH sarvvavit yasya jYAnamayaM tapaH । tasmAdetadbrahma nAma rUpamannaYca jAyate” ityAdi SrutirmmAnam । tAdfSacikIrzAsadBAve ca “so'kAmayata bahu syAM prajAyeyetiSrutirmmAnam । tAdfSakftO ca “tanmano'kurutetyAdi” bAkyam । jYAnecCAkftInAmanyatamagarBaM lakzaRatritayaM vivakzitam anyaTA vyarTaviSezaRApatteH । ataeva janmasTitiDvaMsAnAmanyatamasyEva lakzaRe praveSaH । evaYca lakzaRAni nava sampadyante । brahmaRojagajjanmAdikAraRatve ca “yatovA imAni BUtAni jAyante yena jAtAni jIvanti yat prayantyaBisaMviSantItyAdi” SrutirmmAnam । yadvA niKilajagadupAdAnatvaM jagadAkAreRa pariRamyamAnamAyADizWAnatvaM vA । etAdfSamevopAdAnatvamaBipretya “idaM sarvvaM yadayamAtmA” “saccAsaccABavat” “bahu syAM prajAyeya” ityAdiSrutizu brahmaprapaYcayostAdAtmyavyapadeSaH । GawaH san GawoBAti GawEzwa ityAdilOkikavyapadeSo'pi saMccidAnandarUpabrahmEkyADyAsAt” । ataeva “asti BAti priyaM rUpaM nAma ketyaMSapaYcakam । AdyaM trayaM brahmarUpaM mAyArUpaM tatodvaya” mityuktam । SrIDarasvAminA'pi BAga॰ 1 Slo॰ wIkAyAm “viSvasargavisargAdinavalakzaRalakzitam” ityanena brahmaRaH sargAditrayasya jYAnacikIrzAkftimattvena nava lakzaRAnyuktAni । “mAyopADirayaM jIvohyavidyopADirISvara” ityukteH tasyAvidyopADitvam avidyA ca kAryyakAraRaBedena dviviDA tatra kAryyarUpA mAyASabdena vAcyA kAraRarUpA tu avidyASabdavAcyA । tatra kAryyarUpABiprAyeREva “indromAyABiHpururUpa Iyate” SrutirdrazwavyA । avidyABiprAyerRava tu “mAyAntu prakftiM vidyAt mAyinaM tu maheSvaram” । “AjAmekAM lohitaSuklakfzRavarRRAmityAdi” SrutiSca drazwavyA । tasyA ekatve'pi satvarajastamorUpaguRaBedAt trEviDyena tadupahitacEtanyasyApi trEviDyam । tadaBiprAyeREva “sa ca parameSvaraH eko'pi svopADIBUtamAyAnizWasatvarajastaBoguRaBedena brahmavizRumaheSvarAdiSabdavAcyatAM Bajate” iti vedA॰ pari॰ । “sattvaM rajastama iti prakfterguRAstEryuktaH paraH puruza eka ihAsya Datte । sTityAdaye hariviriYciharetisaMjYAH” BAgavatam । matsyAvatArapraBftayo'pi brahmakowayaeva । ata eva sidDAntavindO “pumAkAravizRupraBftInAM styAkArARAYca BAratIpraBftImAmoSvararUpatvamuktam । tasya nityatayA niravayavatvE'pi tattajjIvAdfzwavaSAt tezAmupAsAsidDyarTaM SrutivedapurARaprasidDAkAragrahaRam “cinmayasyAdvitIyasya nizkalasyASarIriRaH । upAsakAnAM sidDyarTaM brahmaRorUpakalpanetyukteH “yoyo yAM yAM tanuM BaktaH SradDayArccitumicCati । tasya tasyAcalAM SradDAM tAmeva viDAmyahamiti” gItokteSca । ISvaraviBUtiSabde ca darSayizyamARa tattatsTAnezu ISvarasyArADyatA । “yadA yadA hi Darmmasya gnAnirBavati BArata! । aByutTAnamaDarmmasya tadAtmAnaM sfjAmyaham” gItokteH jIvAnAM kAryyavaSAt tasya vigrahavattvenArviBAvaH । kintu svAdfzwAyattaSarIraparigrahasyEva saMsAritvena ISvarasya SarIraparigrahe jIvAdfzwasyEva hetutveneSvarasya na saMsAritvamiti Beda iti drazwavyam । tatra parameSvare “yasminnISvara ityananyavizayaH SabdoyaTArTAkzaraH” vikra॰ “uparyupari budDInAM carantISvarabudDayaH” purA॰ । “jagadAhuranISvaram” gItA “na hISvaravyAhftayaH kadAcit puzRanti loke viparItamarTam” kumA॰ । “kleSakarmmaPalaBogavarjitaM puMviSezamamumISvaraM viduH” mAGaH । AQye “ISvaro'hamahaM BAgIko'nyo'sti sadfSo mama” gItA svAmini । “AtmeSvarArARAM na hi jAtu viGnAH samADiBedapraBavoBavanti” kumA॰ । Sive svAmini ca “prAleyaSItamacaleSvaramISvaro'pi” kumA॰ ESvaryyAnvitastriyAM wAp । “saviDe Sayane'pyanISvarA saPalIkarttumaho manoraTAn” rasaga॰ । durgAyAM tu ISvarapatnItvAvivagfyAM waBeva । “vinyastamaNgalamahOzaDirISvarAyAH” kirA॰ ।
m: ईश्वर mfn. able to do, capable of (with gen. of Vedic inf., or with common inf.), liable, exposed to, AV.; TS.; ŚBr.; AitBr.; Kum.; Hit. &c.

a: ईश्वर — a. (रा-री f.) [ईश्-वरच् P. III. 2. 175] 1 Powerful, able, capable of (with inf.); Ku. 4. 11; R. 15. 7. --2 Rich, wealthy; Pt. 2. 67. --रः 1 A lord, master; ईश्वरं लोकोर्थतः सेवते Mu. 1. 14; so कपीश्वरः, कोशलेश्वरः, हृदयेश्वरः &c. --2 A king, prince, ruler; राज्यमस्तमितेश्वरं R. 12. 11; Ms. 4. 153, 9. 278. --3 A rich or great man; तृणेन कांर्य भवतीश्वराणां Pt. 1. 71; R. 3. 46; Bh. 3. 59; मा प्रयच्छेश्वरे धनं H. 1. 15; cf. “To carry coals to Newcastle.” --4 A husband; नेश्वरे परुषता सखि साध्वी Ki. 9. 39. --5 The Supreme God (परमेश्वर); ईश एवाहमत्यर्थं न च मामीशते परे . ददाभि च सदैश्वर्यमीश्वरस्तेन कीर्तितः ... --6 N. of Śiva; V. 1. 1. --7 The God of love, Cupid. --8 The Supreme soul; the soul. --9 The eleventh year (संवत्सर) of the Śālivāhana era. --रा, --री N. of Durgā; of Lakṣmī; or of any other of the saktis; ईश्वरीं सर्वभूतानां त्वामिहोपह्वये श्रियं. --री N. of several plants and trees; लिंगिनीलता, वंध्याकर्कटी, क्षुद्रजटा and नाकुलीवृक्ष. --Comp. --अधीन a. subject to a lord or king, dependent on a lord or god. --निषेधः denial of the existence of god, atheism. --निष्ठ a. trusting in god. --पूजक a. pious, devout. --पूजा worship of god. --प्रसादः divine favour. --भावः royal or imperial state. --विभूतिः f. the several forms of the Supreme god; for a full enumeration, see Bg. 10. 19-42. --सद्मन् n. a temple. --सभं a royal court or assembly. --सेवा worship of god.

a: ईह् — {c1c} A. (ईहते, ईहांचक्रे, ऐहिष्ट, ईहिष्यते, ईहितुं, ईहित) 1 To wish, desire, long for; have in mind, think of (with acc. or inf.); ईहंते… अर्थसंचयान् Bg. 16. 12, 7. 22; Ms. 4. 15, 3. 126; ऐहिष्ट तं कारयितुं कृतात्मा Bk. 1. 11. --2 To endeavour to obtain. --3 To aim at or attempt, endeavour, strive; माधुर्यं मधुबिंदुना रचयितुं क्षारांबुधेरीहते Bh. 2. 6; Y. 2. 116. --4 To take care of. --Caus. To impel, urge.

ईक्ष् cl. 1. Ā. ईक्षते, ईक्षां-चक्रे (Pāṇ. i, 3, 63), ईक्षिष्यते, ऐक्षिष्ट, ईक्षितुम्, to see, look, view, behold, look at, gaze at; to watch over (with acc. or rarely loc.), AV.; AitBr.; ŚBr.; Mn.; Kathās. &c.; to see in one's mind, think, have a thought, ŚBr.; ChUp.; MBh.; Bhag. &c.; to regard, consider, Kum.; to observe (the stars &c.), VarBṛS.; to foretell for (dat.; lit. to observe the stars for any one), Pāṇ. i, 4, 39 : Caus. ईक्षयति, to make one look at (with acc.), ĀśvGṛ. (This root is perhaps connected with अक्षि, q.v.)
(also) to be seen, Jātakam.
a: ईक्ष् — {c1c} A. (ईक्षते, ईक्षांचक्रे, ऐक्षिष्ट, ईक्षितुं, ईक्षित्वा, ईक्षित) 1 To see, behold, view, perceive, observe, look or gaze at. --2 To regard, consider, look upon; सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं… ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा Bg. 6. 29. --3 To take into account, care for; नाभिजनमीक्षते K. 104, न कामवृत्तिर्वचनीयमीक्षते Ku. 5. 82. --4 To think, reflect; तत्तेज ऐक्षत बहु स्यां प्रजायेय Ch. Up. --5 To require; Pt. 1. 151. --6 To look to, or to investigate, the good or bad luck of any one (with dat. of the person); कृष्णाय ईक्षते गर्गः Sk. (शुभाशुभं पर्यालोचयति); Bk. 8. 76 --With अधि to suspect; सत्येप्यपायमधीक्षते H. 4. 102 v. l. --अन्वव {1} to see, behold. {2} to consider. {3} to care for, take into account.

m: 1. ईति f. (fr. 4. ई?), plague, distress, any calamity of the season (as drought, excessive rain, swarm of rats, foreign invasion, &c.)

a: ईति — a. [ई-क्तिच्] 1 Produced, effected. --तिः f. Plague, distress, a calamity of the season. The ītis are usually said to be six:-- {1} excessive rain; {2} drought; {3} locusts; {4} rats; {5} parrots; and {6} foreign invasions; अतिवृष्टिरनावृष्टिः शलभामूषकाः शुकाः . प्रत्यासन्नाश्च राजानः षडेता ईतयः स्मृताः .. (some read for the second line स्वचक्रं परचक्रं च सप्तैता ईतयः स्मृताः .. making the total number seven); M. 5. 20; Mv. 7. 42; निरातंका निरीतयः R. 1. 63. --2 An infectious disease. --3 Travelling (in a foreign country), sojourning (प्रवास). --4 An affray.
